title: Fixed Inclined Bar Rack and Raised Comb Carriage
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed inclined bar-screen infrastructure appearance. One continuous thick U-shaped channel has a full ground sole and genuinely open ends. Seventeen complete steel-look bars incline upward between full lower and upper crossrails, leaving sixteen actual empty longitudinal gaps. Separate outboard guide rails carry two complete shoes and a raised one-piece comb with sixteen finite teeth positioned in the bar gaps; all teeth join one continuous full crosshead, with finite side clearance in this authored pose. Two rear posts, lower guide shoes, a complete top shaft, two full drums with flange pairs and two retained cables complete the static support and hoist appearance. Unlike the earlier vertical half-open solid sluice plate in C grooves with a threaded spindle and handwheel, this is a visibly open inclined bar bank and a separate crosswise rake carriage. All numeric channel, frame, bars, comb and hoist faces authored together, no gate, drain, grate, hoist or machine mesh imported or extracted. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred over its own channel sole, one modular model zero scenes. One fixed dry waterworks-inspired artwork, no water or debris. No filtering, screening, cleaning, hydraulic flow, gate sealing, rake travel, cable winding, bearing or running fit, drive, load, stability, manufacture, installation, maintenance, potable-water suitability or civil-engineering safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
